# Code Anchors: Publishing Config Resolution

- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/configure.ts` — the in-process epic-filing consumer: resolves the epic's target repo, classification and project through this resolver, defining no reader of its own; the draft's own type frontmatter outranks the configured epic type.
- `components/skills/nxs-gh-create-epic/SKILL.md` — documents the epic-filing skill's resolved inputs and the epic label default.
- `components/skills/nxs-gh-create-story/SKILL.md` — documents the story-filing skill's resolved inputs.
- `components/commands/nxs.close.md` — a stage consumer: resolves the epic's repo once through the shared resolver and threads it onto every issue operation. (#520)
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/classify.ts` — the epic-resolver consumer, now calling the resolver in process; it still never parses settings itself and still reports an unresolvable classification rather than guessing. (#520)
- `libs/workspace/src/manifest.ts` — validates and carries the optional workspace-wide publishing-defaults block that forms this resolver's hub layer; its allowlist is the second registration surface and rejects unlisted keys outright.
- `libs/workspace/src/resolve.ts` — carries those defaults through onto the resolved workspace description.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — the hub-defaults read-out verb, still published and unchanged because the frozen predecessor still calls it, though this resolver no longer does. (#520)
- `libs/portable-tools/src/workspace-github-defaults.spec.ts` — covers that read-out's behavior, including the empty result on a single-repo checkout and on a resolution failure.
- `.nexus/config/templates/workspace-template.yml` — documents the optional workspace-wide defaults block, its allowed keys, per-key inheritance, and the no-code-repo targeting case.
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/worktree.ts` — consumer of the one worktree-base key, now resolved in process; an empty answer still means undeclared.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/resolve.ts` — the precedence chain itself: the invocation/frontmatter/repo/hub/built-in order, the config-root walk, and the specific-over-general fallback.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/settings.ts` — the shallow line-oriented reader over the canonical and legacy settings names, which keeps declared text verbatim.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/hub.ts` — the hub layer read in process from the resolved workspace, guarded on the checkout declaring one and contributing nothing when it will not resolve.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/publishing.ts` — the classification, project-target, repo-target and design-warrant resolvers built on that chain.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/gh.ts` — the remaining live probes and label helpers, each reporting failure as a returned value.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/config-cli.ts` — the resolve, backlog-query, detect-classification and write-github command surface.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/resolve.spec.ts` — precedence, config-root and hub-layer coverage, including the no-spawn single-repo case.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/publishing.spec.ts` — coverage for the classification modes, project keywords and repo specificity.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/configure.ts` — the batch filer's consumer side: resolves repo target, classification and project through this resolver and defines no reader of its own.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/writeback.ts` — seeds the settings block through the shared writer when the repository declares none, never overwriting a key already declared.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/shared-module.spec.ts` — the structural check over that consumer's own sources enforcing the one-place rule rather than leaving it to review.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/configure.spec.ts` — the write-back case written fresh because no carried-across test covered it: a first run seeds and reports, a second reads and probes nothing.
